messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — ran int4 bringup on magnet16k with the new shard-merge path and saw subtle token drift when stitching a long prefix + inflight sequence. repro attached.

Arjun: hmm, can you paste the minimal repro + env?

Maya: spec: magnet16k int4 build, rotary_scale override used (we tried a clamp around 0.999). sequence used: 48k prefix + 4k inflight. steps to repro:
```
python repro.py --model magnet16k --quant int4 --prefix ./fixtures/48k.txt --generate 4k --shard-join on --rotary-scale 0.9972
```
log excerpt: `step=5120 idx=47999 cache_idx=48000 -> token_shift=+1`

Sam: did you try with shard-join disabled? could be split-boundary misalignment.

Maya: yes — with `--shard-join off` the drift disappears. with `--shard-join on` it shows up only when rotary_scale != 1.0. also reproduces if we prepend the prefix (prefix-stitch) rather than keeping it colocated. points to phase wrap / rounding at the boundary combined with quantized kernel rounding.

Trinh: can you dump pre-quant q/k/v for the tokens around the boundary (±8 tokens) and run deterministic softmax for comparison?

Maya: done. uploaded small dumps to s3://redwood-repro/folded-boundary-1709548000/ (files: prequant_qkv_{shard,idx}.npy) and a tiny bisect script: `scripts/rotary_bisect.sh --low 0.95 --high 1.05` — it narrows the flip to ~0.9972.

CI Bot: build #7822 finished for branch `mg/boundary-suture` — 12 tests passed, 1 flaky (cache-aliasing).

Arjun: can you kick off a goldset eval (long_context sweep 5k->50k) to quantify PPL/EM deltas? need numbers before we change the runtime.

Maya: launched job `eval/rotary-boundary-fold-170954` (queue id 4823). will post delta-PPLs when ready. in the short term i added a debug flag `--rescale-at-glue` to re-normalize rotational phase just before quantize and that temporarily prevents the drift in local tests.

Sam: ack. i'll review the shard-join math in the glue path — suspect we assume monotonic idx across shards but our prefill mapping uses per-shard offsets that don't get normalized back into rotational frame before quant. potential fix: run `rotary_apply_scale(phase, offset_delta)` at join.

Maya: also noted that the drift only becomes visible after generation crosses the prefill boundary (so not in short tests). adding a few more long-run smoke tests now (10k+ generation).

Trinh: if we can reproduce with full float (no quant) but still see tiny phase mismatch, that would confirm join math bug rather than quant noise. otherwise it's quantization amplification.

Maya: good point — float-only run looks clean for most seeds; the issue amplifies after quantization and persistent cache writes. uploading side-by-side diffs.

Sam: plan: 1) add phase-normalize step at glue, 2) add a tiny unit test that simulates cross-shard prefix stitch with configurable rotary_scale and asserts no token shift for 1000 steps, 3) rerun goldset eval.

Maya: great. tagging @Sam and @Arjun for follow-up. will keep this thread as the coordination hub. :pray:
